messages.content: Why working mode is reloading the page? Remove the two modes view in the  apps section, always show all options without filter.

## 1. Why "Working mode" reloaded the page

The entry was wired to this method (now removed):

```js
async switchToWorkingMode() {
  try {
    await this.$storex.users.setWorkspaceMode('work')   // saves user doc + bumps revision
    window.location.assign('/')                          // ← full document reload
  } catch (error) { ... }
}
```

`window.location.assign('/')` is a **hard navigation**, not a router push: the browser discards the JS context and re-downloads the SPA. It was written that way deliberately — `isCompanyMode` / `isCompanyAdmin` etc. read `API.user`, which lives on a **non-reactive singleton**, so a full remount was the "guaranteed" way to re-read `workspace_mode`. The cosmetic cost (sidebar, open panels, unsaved composer state all lost) was the price.

Since the mode toggle is now gone from this menu, that reload path no longer exists.

> ⚠️ Related leftover: `onProjectSelected()` **still** ends in `window.location.href = origin/<project_name>` — the same kind of hard reload, even though its own comment says the switch is store-driven and "must never end in a URL/route change". Tell me if you want that converted to a store `activeProjectChanged` call too.

## 2. Changes summary

**File:** `src/components/layout/AppsSection.vue`

| Change | Why |
|---|---|
| Removed the entire `isCompanyMode` branch (Company / Ask codx-junior / Add a person / Build a team / Start a mission / What needs attention / Working mode) | No more mode-specific navigation |
| Removed the `v-else-if` — the single list is now `v-if="primaryNavExpanded \|\| isCollapsed"` | One launcher, always rendered |
| Removed **Working mode** `NavItem` | It was the page-reload trigger |
| Removed computed `isCompanyMode`; header label is now static `APPS` | Mode filtering no longer exists in this component |
| Removed methods `switchToWorkingMode`, `handleNavigateToCompanyHome`, `openCompanyPrompt`, `openCompanyAssistant` | Dead code after the mode block deletion |
| Kept `Company` `NavItem` → `handleNavigateToCompany` (opens the `company` app) | Company stays reachable from the full list |
| Kept project selector, pin button, `ViewModeToggle`, `PinnedProjectsSwitcher` | Unrelated to the mode split |
| Kept `Infrastructure` behind `v-if="$users.isAdmin"` | Backend `/api/infra/*` is admin-only — a permission gate, not a mode filter |

Nothing else changed: identical indentation, no style/format churn, same store calls (`$ui.setActiveTab`, `$ui.openApp`, `$service.chat`, etc.).

## 3. Notes

- `isCompanyMode` still exists in `src/store/users.js` and is consumed by other views/`App.vue` shell logic — only this menu stopped reading it. No store change was needed.
- The mode **value** itself (`workspace_mode`) is untouched, so users who already set it keep whatever shell they land on from elsewhere.

## 4. Accessibility / UX checklist (after the change)

- [x] Single unambiguous launcher — no hidden options based on role/mode, removes the "where did my menu go" failure.
- [x] Section header `APPS` is static text with an icon-chevrón; the toggle button keeps `title="Toggle Primary Navigation"` (still keyboard reachable, `fa-chevron-up/down` gives a non-color state cue).
- [x] All `NavItem`s keep `:is-collapsed` so icon-only mode retains labels via tooltips.

Want me to also replace the `window.location.href` project switch with the store-driven path, so switching projects stops reloading the page as well?
